name: Reborn
description: Aslı Güneş has never truly lived her fragile heart kept her trapped in survival. When she finally receives a life-saving transplant, her second chance comes with a price: the heart belonged to Melike Alkan, heir to one of Istanbul’s most powerful families. Drawn into the Alkan world of wealth, grief, and buried secrets, Aslı becomes both a daughter to a grieving mother and the forbidden love of a restless heir. But while she embraces this new life, her own mother and a dangerous lover scheme to exploit her miracle. Torn between two families, two identities, and one borrowed heart, Aslı must discover who she truly is before love, betrayal, and destiny consume her.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Aslı, a heart patient awaiting a transplant, lives a quiet life with her mother, Hülya, and siblings, Sezin and Murat. She is deeply shocked by what her boyfriend's mother, Sevim, tells her, and she falls ill. Meanwhile, Melike, the daughter of the wealthy and prominent Alkan family, is involved in an accident and loses her life. This loss is devastating for the entire family, especially her mother, Reyhan. When Aslı woke up in the hospital, she practically began a second life with Melike's heart. Reyhan dotes on Aslı, who carries her daughter's heart, while Hülya believes she's been blessed when she learns that the heart that gave her daughter life belongs to Melike Alkan. This situation causes conflict with Aslı, while the Alkans' son, Aras, is reluctant to have Aslı around. However, this sparks a conflicted bond between the two.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The closeness between Aslı and Reyhan causes Hülya to feel jealous. Aras accuses Aslı of taking advantage of Reyhan’s situation, while Aslı rejects these accusations. Figen, who doesn’t want Aslı to come to their house, sternly warns Reyhan about it. Trying to ease his pain over Melike with Aslı’s support, Reyhan becomes furious at the pressure being put on her to stay away from Aslı. Figen takes a new step to keep Aslı away from the house, while Hülya tries to use this situation to her own advantage as much as possible. As Aras and Emre come face to face, Aras sets a new plan into motion. Realizing that he has wronged Aslı, Aras tells her what Melike was really like. As the ice between them begins to melt a little, Hülya is on the verge of making a decision that will greatly upset and shock her children.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Reyhan's understanding and loving approach further strengthens the bond Aslı feels towards her. Taken to the farm by Metin to calm down and relax, Reyhan is not pleased. Meryem's harsh words about Melike's death infuriate Reyhan, and her reaction to what she hears is harsh. Hülya, eager for a fresh start thanks to the deal she made with the Alkans, suffers a devastating blow from Okan and returns to her children. Murat, misunderstanding the situation, takes action to make Okan pay for what he did to his mother's distress. However, this decision puts everyone, especially Aras and Aslı, in a difficult position. Aslı consoles Aras, who feels guilty about Melike's death, and feels the irresistible closeness between him and her even more deeply.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Unwilling to lose Aslı, Emre proposes to her. While Aslı accepts, Hülya is deeply dissatisfied and harshly criticizes him. However, Aslı's words both upset and anger Hülya. Reyhan, who couldn't realize her dream of marrying Melike, wants to fulfill it by organizing Aslı's wedding. Hülya, on the other hand, plans to use this opportunity to her own advantage. Aras, disturbed by the news of Aslı and Emre's marriage, withdraws his job offer to Emre in Denmark. Emre is deeply disappointed, and Aslı, upon learning of the agreement, is left furious. Figen, who doesn't approve of Reyhan's actions for Aslı, opposes her decision and tries to put Reyhan in her place. However, Reyhan overcomes this obstacle with Metin's support. On the other hand, Hülya, who witnessed Aras and Aslı getting closer, has new plans in mind.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As the tension between Aslı and Aras becomes impossible to hide, Hülya’s discovery of their relationship opens the door for her to set her own plans in motion. Meanwhile, following clues about Melike’s past, Aslı gets one step closer to uncovering who she really is. As Melike’s secret-filled life begins to unravel, the balance shifts for both Reyhan and Hülya. After a major confrontation with Figen and Meryem, Reyhan is determined to stand on her own two feet. Hülya, on the other hand, stirs the pot by paying a family visit to Emre’s mother, Sevim. The meeting soon turns into a tense showdown between the two mothers, leaving Hülya feeling helpless in the face of unexpected events. As the shadows of the past collide with the reckonings of the present, the hidden truths everyone has been keeping begin to surface—bringing with them a major crisis.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After the tragedy, chaos descends. As Emre and Aslı confront each other at the hospital, Reyhan, who overhears their conversation, learns everything that happened between Aslı and Aras. Meanwhile, Figen, learning that Aslı was responsible for the incident that caused Aras and Emre's fight, bluntly warns Aslı to stay away from her son. When Figen asks Reyhan to choose between Aslı and her family, Reyhan is forced to leave the house. Her destination is the Aslı family. During this period, Hülya and Reyhan frequently clash, and the tension between them grows. Meanwhile, Aslı and Aras continue to follow leads regarding Melike. However, Aslı, both unable to bear keeping secrets from Reyhan and feeling embarrassed by the Aras situation, unwittingly finds herself in a much more difficult situation.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When Reyhan overhears the conversation between Aslı and Figen, her trust in Aslı is deeply shaken. Her painful words,“Maybe you only pitied me”, are followed by Aslı suddenly falling ill from heart troubles, leaving everyone in shock and forcing tensions to subside for the moment. Meanwhile, the situation on Hülya’s side grows increasingly volatile. Her daughter’s deep attachment to Reyhan drives Hülya to the brink of madness. After Aslı and Reyhan return home, a drunken confrontation between Hülya and Reyhan takes a devastating turn. Hülya’s bitter words leave both women emotionally shattered and push Reyhan to the edge. In the aftermath, Reyhan’s sudden disappearance sends Aslı and Aras into a desperate search to find her, while Hülya struggles under the crushing weight of guilt. But when Reyhan finally returns, determined to be closer to Aslı, she presents Hülya with an unexpected and morally challenging offer, one that will force Hülya to question her own values.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Aslı’s arrival into the Alkan family shakes up not only her own life but also the entire household. What Reyhan believes to be an act of kindness freeing Aslı “for her own good”, soon spirals into a storm that no one can control. While Hülya is forced to confront the shame of having lost her daughter because of money, Sezin and Murat are determined, driven by sibling instinct, to bring Aslı back home. In her desperation, Sezin takes a dangerous path, one that requires money and great risk. The choices she makes will have direct and lasting consequences for all three siblings. At the Alkan mansion, tensions run high as usual. Between Figen’s harsh demeanor, Meryem’s anger, and Metin’s silence, Reyhan struggles to keep control, but it’s Aslı who suffers most in the crossfire. Meanwhile, Reyhan’s protective attitude toward Aslı begins to take on a darker, more obsessive tone, blurring the line between care and control.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Halit’s unexpected return turns everything upside down for both the Alkan family and Hülya. As the dark doors of the past reopen, Reyhan’s courage clashes directly with Halit’s fury. Caught in a far more dangerous battle this time, the Alkan family desperately searches for ways to stand against Halit. But now, the fates of the two families are irreversibly intertwined. The tension sparked by Halit’s arrival quickly escalates into a major crisis. Hülya is forced to face the fears she has been running from for years; Halit’s return is like a nightmare reborn for her. Meanwhile, Sezin remains unaware that her mistake has put both her mother and her sibling in serious danger. Despite everything, Reyhan is unwavering and she is determined not to give up Aslı, no matter the cost.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The armed confrontation between Aras and Serkan turns into a great tragedy. Amidst the confusion, Solak Rıza and his men intervene, and thanks to this, Aras and Aslı manage to escape. But nothing is over. Reyhan goes to Halit, consumed by anger, to demand answers, and experiences a brief moment of relief upon receiving a call from Aslı. However, when she discovers that Serkan has been shot, Reyhan's worry intensifies, and she tries to leave without Halit noticing. Meanwhile, Aras doesn't intend to simply flee as if nothing happened and leave Aslı behind. Therefore, Figen asks Aslı for help in convincing Aras. While the two dream of escaping together and building a new life, Serkan, discharged from the hospital, sets out for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Aras is left severely beaten at the gates of the Alkan Mansion, throwing the household into panic. Meanwhile, Metin and Reyhan learn that Aslı has gone missing. Reyhan’s guilt grows heavier, and Hülya is devastated; not knowing what happened to Aslı consumes both women as well as Aras. During this time, Aslı is entirely at Serkan’s mercy. Serkan takes her to a remote place and threatens her—his goal is clear: to force Aslı into marrying him. When Aslı is finally brought back home, the entire mansion holds its breath. Having narrowly escaped death, Aras vows revenge on Serkan for what he did to her. Reyhan begins to see that Halit’s scheme is spiraling out of control. Just then, Halit makes an even more shocking move, presenting a proposal that stuns everyone. As Aras’s anger rises, Metin swears revenge, and Reyhan continues to hide her secrets, the family finds itself on the brink of an irreversible confrontation.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Following Meryem's death, the Alkan Mansion is plunged into mourning. Asli struggles to cope with both the weight of this loss and the consequences of the secret agreement she made with Serkan. Serkan, increasingly out of control due to the added impact of his parents' divorce, pressures Asli with a medical report and the marriage, dragging her down a path that's hard to turn back from. To keep Aras away from Serkan, Asli asks for help from Figen. Meanwhile, Hülya, upon learning that it was Reyhan who revealed Aras and Asli's whereabouts to Halit, turns this information into a powerful weapon. Asli accuses Reyhan of selfishness and says she no longer wants to live with her; she leaves the house and returns to her mother Hülya's home. Reyhan's breakdown, Hülya's sense of victory, and the impending possibility of marriage with Serkan; all of these open the door to a much larger crisis for both the Alkan family and Hülya's side.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Aslı finds herself cornered enough to sit at the marriage table with Serkan; just as the signatures are about to be made, things take an unexpected turn. Returning home, Aslı is forced to confess everything she's kept hidden up to this day to both her siblings and to Aras, who has rushed to Istanbul. The harsh confrontation between the two evolves into something entirely different with Aslı's panic attack; this time, Aras chooses to stay by Aslı's side. Meanwhile, as Hülya grapples with the guilt from Melike's death and traces the footsteps of the past, Reyhan meets with a lawyer to leave the house in Ada to Aslı. The revelation that Melike was adopted cracks open the door to a major family secret kept hidden for years. Aslı, drawing closer to the truth about Meryem's death, comes face to face with Cahit; this moment when she's face to face with death and the uncertainty of Aslı's fate drag the story into a path that's hard to turn back from for all the characters.
